The color of an eggplant is typically a deep purple, though some varieties can be white, green, or striped.

Regarding the readability of the provided text ("The cat sat on the mat. It was a sunny day, and the birds were singing. There was a gentle breeze that played with the leaves of the trees."), here is an evaluation using standard formulas:

**1. Flesch Reading Ease (FRE)**
*   **Formula:** $206.835 - 1.015 \times (\text{total words} / \text{total sentences}) - 84.6 \times (\text{total syllables} / \text{total words})$
*   **Analysis:**
    *   Total Words: 33
    *   Total Sentences: 3
    *   Total Syllables: 43
    *   Average Words per Sentence: $33 / 3 = 11$
    *   Average Syllables per Word: $43 / 33 \approx 1.30$
    *   Calculation: $206.835 - 1.015(11) - 84.6(1.30) \approx 206.835 - 11.165 - 109.98 \approx 85.69$
*   **Score:** ~85.7
*   **Interpretation:** This score indicates the text is **Very Easy** to read. It is suitable for an average 11-year-old or lower. The simple sentence structure and monosyllabic words contribute to high readability.

**2. Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (FKGL)**
*   **Formula:** $0.39 \times (\text{total words} / \text{total sentences}) + 11.8 \times (\text{total syllables} / \text{total words}) - 15.59$
*   **Analysis:**
    *   Calculation: $0.39(11) + 11.8(1.30) - 15.59 \approx 4.29 + 15.34 - 15.59 \approx 4.04$
*   **Score:** ~4
